thread_title: S. flava var. cuprea 'dark top' Brunswick Co, NC
breadcrumb: S. flava var. cuprea 'dark top' Brunswick Co, NC

posts.body_html: I suppose dark is relative, but a lot of the other cupreas I've grown from Brunswick Co, NC didn't have such a dark top as this one has! Most cupreas in cultivation don't have location data, so it's hard to compare. This was just identified and selected from one of my community trays, it's being evaluated and then most likely propagated in the near future. In any case, this looks like a potentially very nice clone, especially with that yellow-greenish, contrasting interior. Photos taken 5/20/19:
